collection_gate: same boot/run/PID START, RUN_RESULT, SCM_STOP(code0), final VOLUME_FLUSH(code0), TERMINAL(code!=3010); no later REBOOT_REQUIRED without successful request; actual observed UART only
pending_reboot: TERMINAL code00000BC2 requires REBOOT_REQUEST code0 and means wait next Windows START/Resume; no Recovery collect yet
terminal_code0: installer returned an expected deployment phase; not proof of host enumeration, VBUS or power improvement
reboot_budget: logs/planned-reboots.bin, durable per deployment; fifth request returns ERROR_RETRY(1237), no reboot
SCM_stop_observer: same signed EXE --uart-terminal RUN PID RESULT; QueryServiceStatusEx confirms STOPPED; original SCM callback performs no work after SetServiceStatus(STOPPED)
